verdict: Leads are arriving; Google spend and pipeline conversion need immediate fixes.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 140 leads at a cost of $16.01 per lead across $2,241.62 in total spend — all of that lead volume came through Meta. Google Ads consumed $507.73 of that budget and returned zero conversions, and spend on that channel jumped another 49% in the most recent 7 days, so the gap is widening. On the pipeline side, 140 leads entered your system but zero appointments and zero won opportunities were recorded, pointing to a breakdown in how leads are being followed up after they arrive — that is not an advertising issue. Google spend is being reviewed this week, and the intake process is being addressed to ensure leads move forward once they come in. The priority for the next period is stopping the Google budget leak and getting the pipeline moving so the leads already in your system convert into booked appointments.
